settings.title: What CBD is best for focus?
settings.text: CBD can help your brain focus and effectively process information. Taking a 10 mg gummy half an hour to an hour before you need to focus is a great way to harness CBD’s positive effects on concentration.

settings.title: How much CBD should I take for focus?
settings.text: It’s recommended that you start with 10-20 mg of CBD per day and gradually increase by 5mg until you find your optimal dose. Successful customers often report that 30-40mg 2-3 times per day works best.

settings.title: How does CBD affect focus?
settings.text: By managing cortisol levels and releasing dopamine and serotonin, CBD may be able to lift your energy levels, help you maintain focus, support your memory, and help with mental clarity. CBD also regulates the body’s endocannabinoid system – responsible for physiological processes including stress response, memory, mood, sleep, and immune function. So it can leave your mind free of distractions and feeling more wakeful and alert.

settings.title: Can CBD improve focus?
settings.text:
CBD can make you more attentive and focused by stimulating a response within the dopamine receptors in your brain. You could start by having a 10 mg gummy 
an hour before you want to be able to focus, before increasing the dosage if necessary. It’s not recommended to have more than three 10 mg gummies per day.

settings.title: Does CBD affect motivation?
settings.text:
Though CBD isn’t known for having a direct impact on motivation, it can
aid in brain function, therefore supporting energy levels. Being able to think more clearly and tuning
out stress can have wonderful effects and keep you motivated all day!
